_note: Reachability rules, one per advisory, written after reading each advisory's text (linked by id on osv.dev). 'uses' are regular expressions searched in the app's own source; a match means the app uses the vulnerable feature. 'condition' marks advisories that also need something outside the code (platform, attacker position). A package's '_default' rule applies to its advisories without their own rule; it is written for the whole class (for Pillow, any decoder flaw is reachable once the app decodes images it receives).

GHSA-39mp-8hj3-5c49.needs: serving a Gradio app (absolute path traversal)
GHSA-39mp-8hj3-5c49.condition: the server runs on Windows with Python 3.13 or later

GHSA-6655-8ph2-63j3.needs: the Audio component (weak cache key for numpy audio)
GHSA-6655-8ph2-63j3.condition: the attacker already has local access to the server

GHSA-7hp7-4p35-3cx2.needs: proxying an external Space loaded with gr.load() (shared reverse-proxy client)

GHSA-jmh7-g254-2cq9.needs: gr.load() of an attacker-controlled Space (SSRF via proxy_url)

GHSA-wmjh-cpqj-4v6x.needs: serving a Gradio app (CORS origin check on every request)

serving HTTP with Starlette (every Gradio app)
